parameters.name: DeviceTag
parameters.description:
The endpoint device ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries user endpoint devices in batches.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The start time of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the value of To.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The end time of the query time range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than the value of From.

parameters.name: WorkloadType
parameters.description:
The workload type. Valid values:
- **cpu**: CPU usage.
- **mem**: memory usage.
